reasons: The cited termination/term provisions (Sections 13-14) address only continuation of service and Client's duty to arrange a new name server/hosting environment; neither imposes any transition-assistance, data-return or deletion obligation on TrueLink, so the 'missing' status is correctly supported.
The redline is an insertion placed in the correct location (Section 14, Termination) and leaves the original sentence intact, satisfying the minimal-edit standard for a missing-clause insert.

Inserted language tracks the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Client data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter; obligations run against the Vendor, which is directionally correct for us as Customer.
Comment is accurate, in the required tone and prefix, explains the gap, states the playbook position and offers the 90-day fallback without lecturing.

Minor, non-blocking: '(ii) within thirty (30) days of Client's request' adds a request trigger not in the model language, and 'Client's Intellectual Property' is used as if defined; neither changes the substance or weakens the position.
